title: Magnitude 6.0 Earthquake Strikes Timor-Leste
subtitle: Quake at a depth of 10 km was recorded with no reports of being felt
excerpt: A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck Timor-Leste on the morning of August 24, 2026, centered 215 km north-northeast of Lospalos at a depth of 10 km.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A magnitude 6.0 earthquake was recorded by the USGS on the morning of August 24, 2026, at 11:10 (Brasília time), with its epicenter located 215 km north-northeast of Lospalos, Timor-Leste.

Technical details of the earthquake

The quake occurred at a depth of 10 km, according to the USGS technical report. The magnitude of 6.0 indicates a seismic event of moderate strength, capable of producing localized damage depending on the structural conditions of the region.

Impact alert

The USGS assigned a green impact alert to the earthquake, signaling that the expected effect on the population and infrastructure is low. This rating reflects the combination of magnitude, depth, and the remote location of the epicenter.

Tsunami possibility

The tsunami alert issued by the USGS was negative, indicating that there is no risk of significant ocean wave generation from this event.

Report status

To date, no reports have been recorded from people who felt the tremor. Authorities have not yet released additional information regarding potential damage or emergency responses.

Next steps

The USGS will continue monitoring the region to detect any potential aftershocks or changes in seismic activity. Local agencies in Timor-Leste may update the public if new data emerges regarding impacts or safety measures.

Seismic data: USGS.
